name: LL-37

nameVariance.note: Printed name follows the label facts adopted in KAN-59/11584 (Session 3, KAN-59/11393). The catalog names the listing with CAP-18 (display name Ll-37 (Cap-18), variant label LL-37 CAP-18), pairing the peptide with CAP-18, its precursor; the accepted description says the two are not the same molecule (KAN-59/11582), and the facts bar CAP-18 as a name for it. Dataset wording is Root's decision.
